AccessInfo.description: The authenticated principal and effective permissions for this request. Notification contacts are separate resources. Missing permissions never grant access.

permissions.description: Explicit effective permission identifiers, exactly matching case-sensitive OpenAPI operationId values such as CreateMonitor and AcknowledgeIncident. Clients must not infer write permission solely from a role.

role.description: The named principal role: reader or operator. Future unknown roles do not implicitly grant permissions.

executorFenced.description: Whether the original executor is known finished or fenced for review.

held.description: An unresolved action hold; independent of the recorded provider outcome.

outcome.description: Recorded provider outcome classification, unchanged by operator review.

reviewRevision.description: Opaque action observation version required for a conditional operator review.

ActionEvidence.description: Retained provider observation for the original execution, separate from its held outcome and operator assertion. No provider response body is included.

notifyType.description: Actual notification driver key selected by the Code. Requires recipientRefs or groupRef, and excludes inline driver and direct endpointRefs.

contentDigest.description: HMAC of ordinal, identity, source coordinates and exact transmitted resource-object bytes.

id.description: Exact Kind/ID identity bound by the item MAC.

source.description: Opaque ordered source token; never a filename or URL.

applied.description: Optional retained child observation. Absent while the accepted child is pending or when no child exists; explicit false records a terminal child that was not applied. Null is unsupported.

catalogDecision.description: Original conditional decision: accepted, unchanged, conflict, dependencyBlocked or unattempted. A child failure never changes an accepted decision. Unknown future values remain readable.

committed.description: Optional catalog observation; true means a new mutation was accepted, false means none was accepted. Unchanged is successful without a new mutation. Omission means unavailable; null is unsupported.

committedIndex.description: Original decision log index; absent for an unattempted input.

decidedAt.description: Original decision time; absent for unattempted inputs.

generation.description: Generation produced or confirmed by the original decision.

inputOrdinal.description: One-based original input ordinal, defining result page order.

kind.description: Resource kind for collection execution rows. Collection id retains Kind/resourceID; ordinary resource receipts retain their existing id form.

originalUID.description: Original incarnation from the frozen plan guard.

outcome.description: Compatibility outcome observation. For collection execution, catalogDecision and childDisposition carry separate authoritative facts. Unknown future values remain readable.

planOrdinal.description: One-based original execution plan ordinal; independent of input order.

source.description: Opaque original source token; never a source path, URL, fingerprint or key.

uid.description: Incarnation produced or confirmed by the original catalog decision.

resourceOperations.description: Supported operations by resource; availability does not grant authorization.

ticket.description: Private opaque creation ticket; keep in client memory with the original frozen input and omit from diagnostics.

CollectionPrepareRequest.description: Prepare an authenticated creation ticket for one frozen collection before its first Create request. Preparing a ticket never uploads or activates resources.

contentDigest.description: Opaque keyed inventory commitment; requires the original frozen key and bytes to resume.

identityFormat.description: Versioned commitment to exact transmitted resource-object bytes. No JSON canonicalization is performed.

identityKey.description: Private per-frozen-collection HMAC key. Send only to the configured authenticated server. Never return, log or persist unencrypted.

normalizationProfile.description: Optional versioned raw-file normalization contract, bound to the original admission and encrypted collection identity. Omit for unprofiled or typed-resource inputs. This field alone does not enable source reselection.

sourceFingerprint.description: Private keyed source commitment. Source paths and URLs remain client-local.

CollectionReselectionAttempt.description: Bounded observation of an owned, disposable source-reselection attempt. Source bytes include comments and unused text. This response contains no file names, source paths, item digests, source fingerprints, inventory keys or resource plaintext. Verification and remainder upload do not activate configuration.

errorCode.description: Safe failure category; contains no input text, path, provider diagnostic or private commitment.

expiresAt.description: Fixed attempt expiry. Reads and failed requests do not renew this deadline or the original operation.

id.description: Opaque attempt identity. This is not authorization.

nextOffset.description: Next raw byte offset within nextSource; zero after all sources are complete.

nextSource.description: Next sequential source ordinal while input is incomplete; zero after all sources are complete.

normalizationProfile.description: The original supported file normalization profile; no parser source, key or commitment is returned.

operationID.description: The unchanged original collection operation handle.

operationUploaded.description: Observed number of uploaded resources in the original operation; not an activation or execution count.

CollectionReselectionCreateRequest.description: Create a disposable attempt owned by the authenticated original operation owner. The explicit base file normalization profile must match the original operation. This request neither extends the original operation expiry nor creates a replacement operation. Attempts are process-local and unavailable after restart.

Duration.description: Go duration string, e.g. 60s. Never numeric nanoseconds or ISO-8601.

actionKind.description: Original action category, when the event belongs to an action.

controlRevision.description: Original control or incident attention revision, when applicable.

endpoint.description: Original notification endpoint index; explicit zero is retained when applicable.

evidenceRefs.description: Opaque operator-supplied evidence references. CPRa does not fetch these references.

executionRevision.description: Original execution revision, never a configuration or control version.

note.description: Operator note recorded with the original audited event; never provider credentials.

outcome.description: Recorded safe outcome classification; never a provider response body.

ExecutionChildDisposition.description: Controller disposition of the original accepted catalog child. Never substitutes for catalogDecision and never exists for unchanged or rejected rows.

invalidatedByRestore.description: Original explicit restore marker, distinct from ordinary supersession.

outcome.description: applied, projection_failed or superseded; absent while pending.

state.description: pending, completed, failed or partial. Unknown future values are observational only.

updatedAt.description: Original retained terminal observation; absent while pending.

ExecutionResultAvailability.description: Separate result availability, independent of Operation.state. Omission means the server has not reported execution-result support for this operation. Errors remain typed problems.

state.description: pending: original execution or publication has not sealed; ready: immutable pages are available; expired: retained result deadline passed. Unknown values remain read-only. A canceled parent may still be pending.

ExecutionResultCounts.description: Scalar execution observations. Catalog acceptance and controller application are independent; explicit zero is available, omission of the entire object is unavailable.

accepted.description: New catalog mutations accepted. Controller disposition does not change this count.

childInvalidated.description: Accepted children invalidated by explicit restore, separately counted.

childPending.description: Accepted children without a retained terminal disposition.

childSuperseded.description: Accepted children superseded independently of explicit restore.

conflicts.description: Original conditional decisions rejected by a conflicting version or incarnation.

dependencyBlocked.description: Original decisions blocked by their frozen dependencies.

processed.description: Original plan decisions recorded; excludes the unattempted suffix.

unattempted.description: Original inputs never decided, certified by the final stop observation; zero while applying.

unchanged.description: Successful unchanged decisions with no new mutation or controller child.

ExecutionResultSummary.description: Immutable original identities, terminal counters and sealed result descriptor. Presence alone never establishes availability; consult executionResult.state.

accepted.description: New catalog mutations accepted. Controller disposition does not change this count.

childInvalidated.description: Accepted children invalidated by explicit restore, separately counted.

childSuperseded.description: Accepted children superseded independently of explicit restore.

dependencyBlocked.description: Original decisions blocked by their frozen dependencies.

expiresAt.description: Retained result deadline, independent of cancellation receipt expiry.

finalizedAt.description: Immutable finalization time; begins the retention cohort.

itemCount.description: Original input count; public pages follow inputOrdinal, independently of planOrdinal.

outcome.description: Final original parent outcome: completed, partial, failed, canceled or invalidated. Unknown future values are read-only observations.

processed.description: Original plan decisions recorded; excludes the unattempted suffix.

resultID.description: Original activation identity; never regenerated for result publication.

unattempted.description: Original inputs never decided, certified by the final stop observation; zero while applying.

unchanged.description: Successful unchanged decisions with no new mutation or controller child.

value.description: Meaningful only when available is true; units are defined by the containing field.

NotificationGroupSpec.description: Ordered endpoint and recipient references. At least one member is required; groups cannot contain other groups.

applied.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

committed.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

identityFormat.description: Present for collection protocol receipts; the caller must recognize it before uploading, validating or activating.

itemCount.description: Declared frozen collection size. Required by collection protocol receipts; absent for non-collection operations. Null is unsupported.

normalizationProfile.description: Original raw-file normalization contract when declared. Missing means no file profile was recorded. Unknown future values are read-only and must not be used to reinterpret the original inventory.

state.description: Parent progress/outcome. canceled and invalidated stop further decisions but do not imply executionResult.state is ready. Unknown future values remain read-only.

uploaded.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

validated.description: Optional observed progress; omission means not reported. Explicit zero or false is retained. Null is unsupported.

admissionTicket.description: Original opaque ticket returned by PrepareCollection. Keep it with the frozen input. Never replace it automatically after attempting Create. Expired or restored-epoch tickets cannot allocate new operations.

contentDigest.description: Opaque keyed inventory commitment; requires the original frozen key and bytes to resume.

identityFormat.description: Versioned commitment to exact transmitted resource-object bytes. No JSON canonicalization is performed.

identityKey.description: Private per-frozen-collection HMAC key. Send only to the configured authenticated server. Never return, log or persist unencrypted.

normalizationProfile.description: Optional versioned raw-file normalization contract, bound to the original admission and encrypted collection identity. Omit for unprofiled or typed-resource inputs. This field alone does not enable source reselection.

sourceFingerprint.description: Private keyed source commitment. Source paths and URLs remain client-local.

workers.description: Current worker goroutines, including idle workers; not a count of busy executions.

completedPerSecond.description: Absent when completed-execution rate is not measured; consult completedRateAvailable.

dequeuedPerSecond.description: Dequeued jobs per second; this is not a completed-execution rate.

RecipientSpec.description: A notification contact with ordered references to typed notification endpoints; not an authentication principal.

attainment.description: Compatibility alias for resultAttainment, a fraction from 0 to 1; unavailable when no expectations were recorded.

pausedMonitorSeconds.description: Intentional pause exposure inside this rolling window, in monitor-seconds; this is a gauge, not a monotonic counter.

pausedMonitors.description: Current owner-observed intentionally paused monitor count; not missed checks.

StartResponse.description: Only granted from the original live begin permits invocation. Reconcile never grants. Other dispositions report original attempt state with conditional grant and receipt fields.

commitIndex.description: Compatibility observation of the FSM-applied log index; not an independently sampled Raft commit index.

formatVersion.description: Current application snapshot format, distinct from node identity and authentication format versions.

ValidationResultItem.description: Retained, safe validation metadata in original input order. Contains no resource bodies or credentials.

change.description: Known changes: create, update, unchanged. Unknown values are read-only observations.

issue.description: Allowlisted issue code, never a provider diagnostic or source path. Unknown codes are read-only observations.

source.description: Opaque ordered source token; never a filename or URL.

ValidationResultPage.description: A bounded page from one sealed validation result. Pending validation is a problem response, never valid=false. At most 4 MiB encoded response; default 100 rows, maximum 500.

ValidationResultSummary.description: Immutable original validation verdict. Count is retained result rows, distinct from declared input itemCount. A successful plan is not permission to execute.
